name: Pressure Pack Hash Rosin Disposable | Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: A disposable vaporizer containing 1 gram of solventless live rosin. Super Pure Runtz may deliver a euphoric and relaxing high. Its effects may be felt in both the head and body. This strain is known to reduce anxiety and stress, as well as soothe mild aches and pains in the body.
